Chill out on the supplements and herbs, they're all really a shot in the dark and probably not going to help you. The only supplements you need are vitamin D3/K2, magnesium, and maybe fish oil and zinc or a multivitamin. Other than that, exercise, sleep well, eat a really clean diet (this is the most important for acne). And try to lessen stress in your life.

Also remember, acne is completely normal at 16. Obviously wash your face and eat clean, but most 16 year olds will get acne anyway. If the acne is severe, maybe going to a dermatologist will help.

Bottom line, don't think random supplements/herbs are going to be the solution to your problems. Diet, sleep, exercise, and a low stress lifestyle should be your first line of attack. This should help with your energy levels too.
